rke2.reason: Pinned to Kubernetes 1.36 because Cilium 1.20.2 guarantees e2e compatibility through Kubernetes 1.36; RKE2 1.37.0 is newer but outside that guaranteed matrix.

cilium.reason: Use the upstream Cilium chart rather than the RKE2-bundled Cilium 1.19.6 to keep BGP/LB-IPAM and security fixes on the current stable Cilium line.

harbor.reason: 2.15.2 is the latest verified stable Harbor image line found during this review. The latest published harbor-helm chart still targeted 2.15.1, so HA Helm deployment remains blocked until a compatible chart is explicitly pinned and tested.

kubeVip.reason: Not the control-plane VIP baseline. HAProxy plus Keepalived is preferred outside the cluster to remove bootstrap dependency on Kubernetes API availability.
